teaser.message: Hi! 👋 Looking for PVC curtains or brackets? Let's chat!

welcome.title: How can we 👋
welcome.subtitle: Explore PVC strip curtain rolls, magnetic curtains, mounting brackets, or request wholesale quotes.

quickActions.title: PVC Strip Curtains
quickActions.subtitle: Standard, Polar & Anti-Insect
quickActions.reply:
Explore our premium flexible PVC strip curtain rolls designed for thermal insulation, noise reduction, and dust barrier control:

• **Transparent Standard**: High-clarity PVC rolls for warehouses, factories, and commercial doorways.
• **Transparent Reliable**: Available in 1mm, 2mm, 3mm, and 5mm thickness for high-traffic zones.
• **Transparent Supreme**: Extra heavy-duty vinyl engineered for extreme durability.
• **Polar / Anti-Freeze**: Remains flexible down to -25°C for walk-in cold rooms and freezers.
• **Anti-Insect Amber**: Yellow-tinted strips that block flying insects and pests in food & pharmaceutical units.

quickActions.title: Magnetic Curtains
quickActions.subtitle: Hands-Free Auto Seal
quickActions.reply:
Our Magnetic PVC strip curtains provide automatic, hands-free self-sealing for seamless transit:

• **Instant Magnetic Seal**: High-strength embedded magnets snap shut immediately after passage.
• **Climate & Pest Barrier**: Eliminates air leaks to preserve HVAC cooling and block flying insects.
• **Clean & Transparent**: Optical-grade transparency for safe, unobstructed two-way visibility.
• **Ideal For**: Supermarkets, restaurant kitchens, food processing units, and laboratories.

quickActions.title: Collection
quickActions.subtitle: MS, SS202 & SS304 Tracks
quickActions.reply:
Heavy-duty mounting hardware and suspension tracks engineered for secure installation:

• **Mild Steel (MS) Tracks**: Rugged, economical mounting strips for indoor standard doorways.
• **Stainless Steel (SS202 & SS304)**: Corrosion-resistant, food-grade tracks for cleanrooms & coastal areas.
• **Magnetic Curtain Tracks**: Specially engineered header tracks and bottom hold-down strips.
• **Mounting Flexibility**: Universal pre-slotted holes for quick wall or under-lintel ceiling installation.
• **Hardware Included**: Clamping plates, mounting clips, and fasteners.
